reviews.comment: One of the best online classes I've taken, only 3 quizzes (1 gets dropped), 3 exams including the final, and an easy group project. Print out the lecture notes before starting a single lecture, that will help you on quizzes and exams since they're open note! Very interesting lectures, helpful study guides, overall great professor and class.

Super funny guy, has good online lectures, and there's only like 3 quizzes and 3 exams + a project at the end of the semester that determines your grade. Just watch the lectures and take the quizzes/exams, and you'll do fine. Also curves pretty generously at the end.

exam and quiz material always seemed to be a lot easier than expected. the course material is intimidating at times but he seems to test on the simpler concepts. nice prof but does not answer emails. for an optional science credit it does take some time and attention but an A is definitely manageable. he's funny and wants you to do well!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took ATMO 201 online and it was super chill. He also gave extra credit at the end. He's really understanding and cares about his students success, and he does have a lot of lectures but it's not that bad. If you take good notes and pay attention you will do great! I recommend this class.

Mr. Epifanio's lectures were super detailed, though never EVER pertained to the quizzes. Open note everything was good until you realize that nothing in the notes was ever on the exams or quizzes. Took extensive notes just to get a 40 on my last exam. Would not recommend for a life science!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His exams and quizzes are fairly difficult. Open-note but you need to study beforehand because there isn't that much time. His lectures are good but it's a lot of material so be ready. 3 exams and 3 quizzes, and one podcast, and drops the lowest quiz score, but very test heavy. Not the worst course but not a breeze. Great guy though.

Professor E is the best! He gives out lots of extra credit. Test and quizzes are open note but are not extremely easy, they still require some thought process. 10/10 would recommend him for in person! :)
Great class! He give hilarious examples which really help seal in the content. 3 quizzes, 3 tests (both open note) and one group project. Super well organized!

Professor Epifanio seems like he's probably overall nice, but the two biggest downfalls are quizzes and exams are nearly impossible to succeed on and he's sort of impossible to reach. I've tried emailing him before and gotten no response. I've tried genuinely locking in for his class, even though it's supposed to be an online easy A, and no help.

Professor Epifanio seemed like a nice man; however, he never responded to my emails. His exams are more critical thinking than atmospheric topics, in my opinion. I assume the class would be better if taken in person. I would take it with a different prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Very good, Professor. I took the online section, which has three exams, three quizzes (he drops one), and a podcast assignment. Exams and quizzes are open note. 

You do HAVE to watch his lecture videos!

Prof E is great. If you're looking for an easy Life and Physical Science, definitely consider this class. No homework, all quizzes and exams are open note, and extra credit opportunities given every lecture. Not to mention, Prof E is super passionate and ready to teach his class. Also super funny! Take him!!!!!
Open note. Textbook not needed, all exam content in videos. Exams available over a 3-day period. He comes off as a bit scatterbrained in his emails.

Easy, but the class does require some effort. If you thoroughly understand his lecture videos and slides, the quizzes and exams are light. They're also open-note. One easy group project towards the end of the semester, and he gives some extra credit.
Free class, open notes on everything, but get ready to think critically for exams and quizzes
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class with a funny guy! If you show up to all the classes, you can get ~12 extra credit points from questions. All of the quizzes and exams are open note, taken directly from the slides, so make sure you have the slideshow PDFs available to reference the figures. Only one simple group project at the end.

I watched every video and took detailed notes, but exams and quizzes were still very difficult. He does allow you to use notes on both but does not give enough time for you to look through them while taking the exams or quizzes. Failed almost every quiz and barely passed on the exams and I ended up with a C. Would never take this class again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A fun guy who really tries to support his students. There's no homework, no need to read the textbook, and I half pay attention in class. However, the open note quizzes and exams are so easy that I ace them with an hour of prep work. There's extra credit too if you go to class. I asked a few questions outside of class and he's always happy to help.

Lectures are posted weekly. He talks slowly, so you can watch on 2x speed and still retain everything. On 2x speed, about 45 minutes of work per week. Exams and quizzes are absurdly easy because they're open note. If you watch the videos and then cram for each exam/quiz for about 15 minutes, you will get a very easy A. Pretty interesting too.
Insanely boring videos every week, can easily watch on 1.5x, quizzes and tests are pretty difficult. I managed to get an A with try Harding, but this is not a blow off class. I wouldn't take it again
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Epifanio tries his best to make lectures interesting, however they sometimes drag. He gives extra credit for all 3 exams. This class is very simple and you will get an A if you watch all of the lectures. Highly recommend!
His teaching style is very cool, calm, and collected. He makes ATMO understandable and easy to listen to.

Posted lectures and exam reviews late. Talks slowly, had to watch in 2x speed and he was still slow. You can use notes on exams and quizzes, so write everything down and pay attention. Total of like 10 grades but fail one and your A is gone.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my favorite courses I've taken. The textbook isn't required and most of the content comes from the video lectures. Exams/Quizzes are open note so take good notes. There is an easy podcast project at the end. He gives some extra credit As well. Also he drops some jokes in the middle of the recordings which I found hilarious.
He posted our exam late and never responds to emails. not an easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes a nice guy but his tests are VERY difficult. Hes always about 20-30 minutes late to office hours, does not respond to emails whatsoever which is frustrating and is very unacessable. This class is extremely test and quiz heavy those being the only 2 grades. Take a more responsive professor, I would not reccomend him.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I dropped this class. Professor seems nice but does not answer emails & often posts important things extremely last minute. I failed every test & watched all the lectures/took notes for everything. He uses lockdown browser for tests and quizzes (not given enough time to use notes). I would recommend a different online class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Epifanio's class is not supposed to be difficult, but it is. He is extremely unresponsive and will post test reviews/lectures much later than anticipated, so it's difficult to even stay on top of the class. The tests are difficult and you're given barely enough time to take quizzes. VERY lecture and test heavy - stay on top of everything.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall this class was not bad. I am personally not a great test taker and this class is graded on 3 exams, 2 quizzes, & 1 group project. He does curve the class which is nice! He is very funny during lectures and overall I did enjoy them. I took this for an easy science credit & it was. Study & take good notes!

This was a fully asynch class, all quizzes and exams are open-note. The lectures are recorded and uploaded to a separate class website, and they're pretty easy to go through. I'd suggest not letting them pile up, it's still doable if you do but it's easier to do them as you go. Overall an easy credit and prof Epifanio drops some fun dad jokes.

I took his class online and its pretty simple. He just posts a bunch of pre-recorded lectures. They're slow and boring but you can watch at 3x speed a day before the test and do great. He wont rlly respond to emails but overall the class is built to make you get an A. Only has a few quizzes, tests and one project.

Very lecture heavy, I would have over 50 pages of notes on google docs for 1 exam. There are barely any grades so the exams are really important. The quizzes are open note but he gives you an extremely short amount of time to do them so you do not have any time to actually look at your notes. He is a nice professor but I don't recommend this class.
This professor has 3 exams, 3 quizzes, and one group project. He gives out extra credit and explains difficult questions before the exam.

Professor Epifanio has all of his lectures posted at the beginning of the semester with a loose schedule to follow. It's easy to work at your own pace up to the quizzes and exams, which are open note on lockdown browser. He wants his students to succeed and make good grades. He is incredibly kind and will do whatever he can to help you!
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He gives very thorough lectures of the material and you are able to have a notecard for exams so you don't have to worry about memorizing a bunch of formulas. The labs and problem sets can take some effort, but he was very open to helping you through it.

I took this class online and would not recommend it under this format. He is a funny guy and really nice. But you have few grades. 3 Quizzes, 3 tests and a group project. He does drop the lowest quiz grade however. He is a good professor, but the online format made it more challenging .
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took during the spring semester. I felt the class overall wasn't too bad. The quizzes were easy enough if you paid attention to the lectures. I personally felt the exams were a little tough compared to the quizzes. The podcast project wasn't bad, but it seems like it was graded harshly considering most of the class only got a B on it.

He does not respond to hardly anyone in this class which makes it very frustrating when you have a question that you would like answered. You are better off asking your peers simple questions about the logistics of the class. For the class being completely online, I would have hoped that he would have cared more to respond to the students.
Really boring lectures. This man is super monotone. I found the quizzes to be harder than the actual exams. Grade is based on 2/3 quizzes, 2 exams, a group podcast project, and a final exam.

Pretty good overall! Pros: asynchronus, funny lectures, detailed slides, caring, give you a time period to do quiz/test, relaxed. Cons: Sometimes he gets quiz overview vids out a hair late. I mean, pretty solid class where you actually learn something useful sometimes. The man uses good examples and all. Tests aren't too bad, quizzes are alright to

Class consisted of 3 quizzes, lowest score dropped, 2 exams, a final, and a group podcast. I found the subject matter of all of these to be easy if you watch his asynchronous lectures and write down the annotations he writes you will easily get an A in his class.

This course was very well organized and straight forward. His tests are very lecture heavy but easy. He makes his tests so that if you watch lecture and take notes it's so easy. He also makes test reviews that are very nice guidelines to study. Lectures are asynchronous and easy to follow. Easy A for those who try.

Dr. Epi is great! He writes lecture notes word for word and draws diagrams every day - even better, they're legible. He genuinely wants you to succeed in his class. Only complaint is that he tries to guide you as little as possible when you ask for help on a lab or homework. You'll really have to push to get the help you need.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dynamics is hard, but Dr. Epifanio made it enjoyable. He is very funny and genuinely cares about his students, and he goes out of his way to help you if you need it. He dedicated some lab days to go over some homework problems for each homework. Make sure to take notes because he doesn't post any online. Tests were somewhat similar to the homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I had Dr. E for ATMO 201 online, and he's one of the best professors I've ever had - he slips a ton of jokes into tests and quizzes and lectures, and he's a super funny and entertaining and quirky guy. On top of that, his lectures are really concrete and he builds from the ground up, so it's really hard to get lost. 10/10 would do it again.

The class consisted of 3 exams and 3 quizzes (drops the lowest quiz grade) and there's so many powerpoint slides that I would expect him to post a more in depth review for the exams but no. Some of the questions on the exam had nothing to do with the lectures. Don't take him.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are very good videos and he gives slide to follow along and fill in blank notes. Concepts are easy to pick up b/c they're explained clearly. Watched 50% of the vids and still managed to pull an high B - mid A on all 3 of his tests. 1/3 quizzes gets dropped and he curves. Really chill guy and class. Don't mess with Craig or I'll find you.

The professor is amazing BUT this was certainly much more difficult that I anticipated. I took notes, watched all the lectures, and simply couldn't keep up with the material - I just couldn't understand it. It really is just me as I am not a science brain and in all honestly, I couldn't grasp the concepts. Super stressful.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love Craig!! He is super funny and was the reason I didn't skip class. There is an extra credit question nearly every class (with varying difficulty) . A quote from test day to show personality: "Wow, I didn't know there were this many people enrolled in this class." He curves letter grades, and allows a cheat sheet for tests. 11/10 prof.

Be prepared that this is a not a blowoff class. The prof is super caring and sent out daily lecture reminders and kept us updated on exams and quizzes so we were never behind. The quizzes and exams are difficult even with heavy preparation for them so don't slack off on the lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: While Prof. Epifanio is extremely clear and concise in his lectures (online, at least), the test questions are very tricky IMO. I always felt that what he taught and explained in his lectures was easy to understand and quite simple, however I made a 69 on my first exam, and I took great notes and studied well beforehand. Confused and disappointed..

Professor Epifanio is overall a really nice and caring professor. Although he took a while to post grades and notes, If you went to class and took notes of your own the exams were not bad. You have 3 exams and 3 quizzes. Labs were a bit much at times. I actually really enjoyed the course. I would take him again. He really cares about his students.

Professor Epifanio really cares about his students & wants everyone to do well. His lectures can drag a little bit but it's only because he wants to be sure that everyone understands. Quizzes/tests are pretty easy, lecture notes are posted online, and the one group project was also easy. Overall a very sweet and kind man, would recommend his class.

I took this course expecting an easy A, because that is what everyone claimed it to be. It was definitely NOT easy whatsoever. This was my hardest class (As a Junior taking accounting & business management, two very hard courses). Anyways, if you do take this class, PAY ATTENTION and study and you could end up with an A, but it won't be easy.
reviews.ratingTags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He's nice and funny but terrible teacher. If you're expecting an easy A, take something else. Seems easy but tests are hard and lectures aren't helpful. He takes weeks to put grades in so it makes it hard to see where you're at grade wise. Only put them in for the Q-Drop date. He does offer extra credit but it doesn't do much for your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof Epi is very chill and funny! Although, he posts grades SUPER late which makes it hard to keep up with how you're doing in the class. This was supposed to be an easy A but i found it more difficult than that. 2 Quizzes, 3 Exams, & a Final. He does ask EC questions on Fridays so definitely go then! His lectures help to learn the material.
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hes aight

Professor Epifanio was phenomenal. I took an online ATMO 201 class over the summer, and even though it was very time consuming, Prof Epifanio made it interesting. He's very quirky and funny, but that just made the class even better. I would definitely recommend him to anyone!

Professor Epifanio is a good professor. If you need to take atmo 201 take it with him. It's not a very difficult subject and he doesn't make it any harder than it needs to be. He does a good job of explaining things and will always answer questions. His emails are hilarious by the way. Definitely recommend.

Dr. Epi is great! He posts all of his lectures online, so attendance isn't mandatory; however, he does give extra credit points on a poll question system (like clicker quizzes). 2 quizzes and 3 exams, all of which were multiple choice with some short answer on the exams. 1010!

He's an excellent professor! The material is easy, but the lectures are engaging and give you enough information to understand everything from daily temperature to hurricane systems. I'm surprised by how much information I've retained and what I can obtain from weather forecasts. I strongly recommend him! Easy A and fun class!

Epifanio is such a nice guy! He has a quirky and nerdy sense of humor. He uploads his powerpoints online on his website, so attending class isn't mandatory; however, I recommend attending because it helps to understand the concepts. 3 quizzes, only counts highest 2 grades. He allows you to use a half-sheet of paper as a "cheat sheet" for the exams.
